from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted profit data from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company whose report this is")
    total_profit: float | None = Field(description="The '利润总额' reported in the statement; use negative for losses")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    source_table: str | None = Field(description="The financial statement section where the value was found, e.g., '合并利润表'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt showing the line item and value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profit_records: list[CompanyProfitRecord]
